user.title: Connect to Realiser A16
user.description: Enable the TCP command server on the A16 (Settings > Network) and enter its fixed IP address and TCP command port.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address configured on the A16.
data_description.port: TCP command port configured on the A16 (default 4101).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address, the port and that the TCP command server is enabled. The A16 accepts only one controller at a time: close other control apps (e.g. Centro Control) and try again.

init.title: Realiser A16 options
init.description: Change the TCP command port. It must match the port set on the A16. The integration reloads after saving.

not_reachable.message: Cannot connect to the Realiser A16 at {host}. Another control app may hold the only connection the A16 accepts.

command_failed.message: The Realiser A16 did not execute the command: {error}

mute_failed.message: The Realiser A16 did not confirm the mute state.
